collection.description: An explorer ignores a safety signal and puts a companion in danger.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: An explorer disregards a safety signal and endangers a companion.

choices.label: Own the mistake and lose standing temporarily.
Help the companion and rebuild trust.
Dismiss the warning and face worse consequences.
Develop a new expedition safety rule.

outcome.name: Ending
outcome.text: The decision may restore confidence, create a new apprenticeship, change profession or duties, or expose a preventable error. An honest admission can still bring accountability; concealment may appear to work initially but create a delayed callback.
